t: The Flomasta Electrolytic Compression Connection Scale Inhibitor 15mm provides effective whole house protection against limescale build-up in plumbing and heating systems. This essential device uses an electrolytic water treatment method, eliminating the need for chemicals, ongoing maintenance, or earth bonding. It is ideal for new installations or upgrades in residential properties, ensuring longevity for boilers and appliances. Designed for 15mm compression pipe, the unit offers flexible installation, mounting vertically or horizontally, and operates efficiently up to 10bar pressure.
b: Requires No Chemicals, Maintenance & Earth Bonding
Mounts Vertically & Horizontally for Flexible Installation
